Proof in the paper: The lattice spacings from the HAADF-STEM image of a single particle are calculated to be 0.436 and 0.230 nm, which correspond to the (021) and (205) planes of the intermetallic PtCu, manifesting that the Int-PtCuN/KB nanoparticles prepared have an ordered intermetallic R3̅m rhombohedral L11 structure.
